scope: native-only ABI 11 Registry chunk streaming and Android process-death callback recovery
verified_behaviors: native callers can prepare and recover only the manifest-derived Registry chunk ledger owned by Rust
one process-wide session accepts only the exact signed transfer, artifact role, chunk index and durable resume offset
each native block is bounded to 1 through 256 KiB and cannot overrun the signed chunk length
Rust rehashes an existing partial once when opening a session and reports separate written and durable byte counts
automatic 4 MiB and exact-completion sync plus explicit checkpoint/suspend preserve resumable prefixes
controlled runtime stop checkpoints an active chunk session before quiescing
wrong hash deletes the partial and returns the signed ledger row to Planned; stale or out-of-band mutations fail closed
ABI 11 C/JNI receipts contain bounded identities and progress but no URL, credential, filesystem path, database handle or transport authority
Android 16 checkpoints 300 fixture bytes, starts a fresh process from a native broadcast, resumes the same nonce and closes BytesComplete after all three chunks
Android installation-material creation is serialized process-wide so concurrent startup reconciliation cannot observe a half-created marker/envelope pair
UIDT startup reconciliation catches custody-open failure inside its zeroizing boundary so unexpected restore remains fail closed without an uncaught background-thread process crash
limitations: no production HTTPS URL, credential, owner-approved descriptor or production trust profile is present
the Android JobService and iOS URLSession adapters still do not feed network response bodies into the native stream
the 6 KiB public debug fixture and isolated callback gate do not qualify full-size Registry transfer or UIDT inventory reconciliation
whole-artifact verification, immutable release assembly, activation, health, rollback and real 2.2 GB qualification remain open
power-loss, Doze, thermal, reboot, Task Manager Stop and physical-device matrices remain open
